content: Oh no, not again! This happens every day.
Look at the mess, Jim. You have your supper and never do the washing up afterwards.
I don't do the washing up. But I wash the car every week.
I don't care about that. You never help me with the housework.
That's not true, darling. I prepare your meals, right?
Oh, so what? The kitchen's always a mess afterwards. You cook meals, and I do the rest everyday.
Calm down. OK. I will do everything in our house from next weekend.
